title: Compare two pricing models
fallback: Illustrative monthly pricing: Plan A costs $20 plus $0.08 per unit; Plan B costs $5 plus $0.20 per unit. At 100 units they cost $28 and $25. Break-even is 125 units. Change usage to compare; these are assumptions, not current vendor prices.
